content: {"argument": "The removed condition specifically handled cases where removeSingleSlash was false and the pathname was exactly '/'. Its removal means that when removeSingleSlash is false, the function now relies solely on the subsequent condition to remove trailing slashes, which requires options.removeSingleSlash to be true. Since the test sets removeSingleSlash to false, the trailing slash preservation logic is bypassed, causing the function to incorrectly add a trailing slash for root URLs that originally lacked it. This constitutes an unintended regression because the behavior change affects a specified option's functionality without announcement in the PR title.", "concedes": true}
